name: paul-hammant/htmlsanitizer
description: Clean HTML of constructs that can lead to XSS. A thin ext-ffi binding over the shared HtmlSanitizer native engine — no sanitizer logic lives in PHP.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the 12-check binding conformance suite (no dependencies required).

suggest.ext-ffi: Required at run time; the engine is loaded with FFI::cdef.
